description:
Ship the canonical single-call wrappers per the `.7` decision.

Each wrapper:
- Constructs a sane `&[&dyn VerificationPolicy]` stack.
- Calls `verify()`.
- Returns `VerifyReport`.

Expected wrapper set (final list from `.7`):

- `verify_tls_server(cert_bundle, trust, hostname, time)` — required.
- `verify_tls_client`, `verify_smime_signer`, `verify_code_signer` — likely.
- `verify_smime_recipient`, `verify_time_stamper`, `verify_ocsp_responder` — maybe.

Each wrapper bakes the defaults chosen in `.7` (revocation mode, lint catalog inclusion, profile, time-source).

Documentation: each wrapper's rustdoc shows the equivalent explicit-stack call so users can graduate from the wrapper to the explicit `verify()` form.

Test surface: each wrapper exercised against a positive and negative cert chain for its use case.

**Blocks on:** .7 (wrapper set + defaults).
title: Implement ergonomic single-call wrappers
